_help: REQUIRED for the search service: keywords and locations. Everything else has defaults. See docs/inputs.md.

sources._help: jobtech and employer_sites are collected by the engine itself ('./run.sh collect'). confirm_leads opens links found on careers pages and reads the posting (up to confirm_leads_max per run). OPTIONAL aggregators, off by default: jsearch (Google for Jobs: LinkedIn, Indeed and company sites; needs jsearch_api_key in inputs/secrets.json; each page is one request of your plan), adzuna (19 countries, not Sweden/Denmark; needs adzuna_app_id and adzuna_app_key), hn_who_is_hiring and yc_jobs (Hacker News, no key). Aggregators need a 'country' on each location. indeed, linkedin_read_only and web_search are used by the AI agent, if you run one.

enrichment._help: OPTIONAL AI review of collected postings. Needs an Anthropic API key in ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or inputs/secrets.json. Costs are per use on your API account.
